photo.name: photographic print
photo.title: photographic print
photo.reason: Documentary portrait of a woman in traditional patterned wrap-cloth and a distinctively knotted headcloth, set by a riverbank in Gabon, consistent with Mpongwe dress; no evidence against the ethnic attribution.

jewelry.name: necklace
jewelry.title: necklace
jewelry.reason: A necklace of ivory tusk-shaped pendants alternating with strands of black and white beads, attributed to the Mpongwe of Gabon by the museum — a plausible traditional jewelry type for this coastal Gabonese people.

jewelry.name: necklet
jewelry.title: necklet
jewelry.reason: A necklace of dark beads, pale stone beads, and animal teeth/tusks, made and worn as personal adornment—consistent with Mpongwe jewelry traditions, and directly attributed by the museum to Mpongwe makers.

jewelry.name: necklace
jewelry.title: necklace
jewelry.reason: A strand of glass trade beads with a central cylindrical beaded pendant, a typical West/Central African beadwork necklace consistent with Mpongwe-made adornment; museum credits it directly as Mpongwe-made.

garment.name: belt
garment.title: belt
garment.reason: A beaded belt with geometric lozenge patterns and long twisted-bead cord tassels, museum-attributed to Mpongwe make; this matches known Gabonese Mpongwe beadwork belts worn as garments/adornment.

arms.name: kniv, dolk, knife
arms.title: kniv, dolk, knife
arms.reason: The image shows a leaf-shaped dagger with a decorated bronze/brass hilt, matching the described type from the Gabon/Ogooué region; Siroto's note attributes this dagger type to Mpongwe and related Balumbu-complex peoples rather than exclusively Fang, supporting the claimed attribution.

instruments.name: Drum
instruments.title: Drum
instruments.reason: A wooden drum with hide head lashed on with cord/strips, consistent with Central African (Gabonese) construction; museum attributes it to the Mpongwe people.
